verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe real-time, low-latency teleoperation over a peer-to-peer WebRTC connection, controlled by joystick, buttons, or custom controls through configurable teleop interfaces. For constrained networks, the docs mention a low-bandwidth agent mode and a durable command queue that delivers requests when the device is back online. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of live video streaming during teleop (only implied by WebRTC and time-synced video records), latency or network-condition specifics, and independent or hands-on corroboration of responsiveness over real-world networks.
